name: metrifi
description: One MetriFi sign-in connects Codex to the MetriFi platform (Site Builder, GEO AI-search visibility, and CRO analytics) and adds the MetriFi skills: client-report for auditing an institution's existing site, generate-claude-design-system, generate-claude-design-page and page-design-process for designing and building one, campaign-setup for standing up a new institution's first baseline campaign, and the GEO experiment skills that run a campaign from research through to a reviewed client deliverable.

interface.longDescription:
MetriFi connects your AI tool to the MetriFi platform, where credit unions and banks build and improve their websites. One sign-in with your MetriFi account turns on three products plus the skills that know how to use them. Authentication is OAuth; there are no tokens to paste and no credentials in the plugin.

Site Builder: generate a brand and design system, build and edit pages, manage effective-dated rates, preview, and publish.

GEO: measure how visible an institution is when consumers ask AI assistants questions, then run an experiment from keyword research to a reviewed client deliverable.

CRO: build Google Analytics funnels, compare them, and generate conversion recommendations from real traffic.

The bundled skills carry the methodology: auditing an existing site, designing and building a new one, and running a GEO experiment end to end, including a four-part pre-publish review covering content hygiene, NCUA and lending compliance, WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility, and fact verification against the institution's live site.

Requires a MetriFi account. Everything the plugin can reach is scoped to your team and your role on it.
capabilities: Audit a credit union or bank website and report what is hurting conversions
Generate an institution's brand tokens and design system from its existing site
Design and build new website pages against an established design system
Manage effective-dated rates and find every page that uses a rate
Preview a site before publishing and publish when approved
Measure how visible an institution is when consumers ask AI assistants questions
Run a GEO experiment from keyword research to a reviewed client deliverable
Review a draft for content hygiene, NCUA and lending compliance, WCAG 2.1 AA, and facts
Build Google Analytics funnels and compare them on a dashboard
Generate conversion recommendations from real traffic
Manage MetriFi teams, members, roles, and invitations
defaultPrompt: Audit https://examplecu.org and tell me what is hurting conversions
Start a GEO experiment for this team on home equity loans
Add a first-time homebuyer page to our site
